00528| /// in an `if: always()` step. The first draft of that step read
00529| /// `kill "${CAPACITY_SAMPLER_PID:-0}"`, and `kill 0` is not a no-op: POSIX
00530| /// defines PID `0` as *every process in the sender's own process group*, so
00531| /// whenever the sampler step was skipped -- which is exactly what happens when
00532| /// an earlier step failed -- the cleanup step would have signalled its own

00544|                 continue;

00549|                 || trimmed.contains("kill 0")

00556|                  group\"). Guard it with `[ -n \"${{VAR:-}}\" ]` instead, so a \
00557|                  diagnostic that never started cannot fail the job (issue #1076)",
00558|                 lineno + 1
